resolved_conflicts.conflict: Six ordered regions could be read as permanent geometry.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: They are six semantic contribution capabilities. Visibility is conditional and omission occurs before geometry.

resolved_conflicts.conflict: Reference images show many populated tabs, queues, rails, and inspector sections.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: Images are populated examples only and cannot create inventory requirements.

resolved_conflicts.conflict: A separate or macOS-first rich-host implementation could be inferred from local webview wording.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: Pi extension is the implementation owner and ships one shared semantic product on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the canonical Git pipeline.

resolved_conflicts.conflict: Missing capability or data could be represented by persistent unavailable/degraded cards.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: Dependent contributions and dead actions are omitted; diagnostics remain internal or contextual.

next_phase.title: Canonical composition schemas and generated contracts
next_phase.boundary: P02 defines portable data contracts only; core resolver implementation begins in P03 and rich-host UI begins in P04/P05.
